name: Summer Games VR
summary:
Summer Games VR offers an immersive virtual reality experience that transports players into a world of athletic prowess and competitive spirit with a variety of engaging modes, including Practice, Single Player, Tournament, and Multiplayer.

Thrilling Sports Lineup:

Archery: Test your precision and focus as you aim for the bullseye in this classic event.
Javelin: Master the art of the javelin throw, harnessing power and accuracy to achieve record distances.
